Signed-off-by: Yuxuan Ye <yuxuanye@microsoft.com>

### Description of PR

ipfwd/test_mtu.py supports IPv6 test

Summary:
Fixes #3603

### Type of change

- [ ] Bug fix
- [ ] Testbed and Framework(new/improvement)
- [x] Test case(new/improvement)


### Back port request
- [ ] 201911

### Approach
#### What is the motivation for this PR?

Improve test_mtu to support IPv6 test

#### How did you do it?

Add check_icmpv6_mtu and check_ipv6_mtu modeled on the original function. To test if icmpv6 packets can reply successfully and if ipv6 packets can be forwarded successfully

#### How did you verify/test it?

Run a test on t1-lag topo, and verify the capture is correct or not
